description: This PHP class 'ViewExportcustomizations' is part of the SuiteCRM system, extending SugarView to handle exporting customization configurations. It includes methods to generate module titles and display a customization export interface, utilizing Smarty templates and AJAX components.

classes.name: ViewExportcustomizations
classes.description: A view class that facilitates exporting customizations within SuiteCRM

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including the module name and title

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares data, assigns variables to Smarty, constructs an AJAX response to show the export customizations interface
